experiment: E-01, donor-only engine validation of the two free donor candidates at fixed geometry
summary: The precursor stopped at its first SCF job, P-RKS-core, when Psi4 aborted during conventional (PK) integral setup with PSIO_ERROR 17 (Incorrect block start address) on unit 92; no SCF iteration was printed. No converged electronic energy or gradient of either donor was produced, and every dependent criterion is INDETERMINATE. The activated donor was not run. The cause of the abort has not been diagnosed.
derivation: Values are transcribed without change from the private run records named in 'sources', each identified by SHA256. Engine output and error text are published in results/e01/raw/ with the redactions stated in provenance/EXPORT-MANIFEST.md.

hypotheses.status: ranked, untested; no cause is asserted
ranked: a large-file or block-address handling failure in the shared conventional PK / PSIO path
scratch capacity or another filesystem or I/O condition; disk exhaustion at the abort is neither established nor excluded
a precursor-dependent trigger such as its size or its iodine-containing integral workload; nothing isolates the failure to this species

proposed_next_steps.status: proposal only; not executed and not authorized
proposed_next_steps.A: tabulate what the existing records contain; they give no failing byte offset, no PSIO block unit or address representation and no mapping from batch index to address, so no inference is drawn
proposed_next_steps.B: optional single filesystem-only probe (large sequential write, reads at large offsets) under stated bounds; it never runs the PK / PSIO code path, so its success cannot weaken the first hypothesis
proposed_next_steps.outstanding: the PK / PSIO question needs a separately authorized, source-informed diagnostic of the engine's own code path
proposed_next_steps.C: only afterwards, a revised configuration proposal (for example a different SCF algorithm with a named auxiliary basis, or PK on storage verified for the file sizes), each subject to review
proposed_next_steps.governing: completing A and B, including a successful probe, does not resolve the shared PK / PSIO risk
proposed_next_steps.instrumentation: any future attempt samples scratch free space and file sizes through to termination, with the sampling interval recorded; a value between samples remains unobserved
